fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: any GEO Profile target row is pagination, retmax, retstart, idlist, or total-hit-count QA; training_source and target_source overlap; official bundle hash differs from the source hash registered in the report; vmax comparator is not worse than the model residual on any heldout target

incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: predict the same GEO Profile heldout rmean target using official visible vmax
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual per GEO Profile row; aggregate mean absolute residual
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: mean_model_residual < mean_comparator_residual and every negative control is rejected

residuals.material_margin_rule: mean_model_residual < mean_comparator_residual and every negative control is rejected

source.source_authority: NCBI GEO Profiles through E-utilities ESearch/ESummary
source.source_name: NCBI GEO Profiles through E-utilities ESearch/ESummary

target_variable.name: NCBI_GEO_Profile_ranked_mean_expression
target_variable.unit: official GEO Profile rmean count/rank value

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual per GEO Profile row; aggregate mean absolute residual
uncertainty_requirement.rule: deterministic official GEO Profile ranked-score residuals with zero added measurement slack
